integrity: Exact standard-library verification of the 24 line parameters, all 276 intersections, 256 exhaustive binary assignments, and integral lattice determinants. Self-review; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only reduced cubic subdivisors of the specified 24-line Schur divisor are classified.
The generated rank-16 lattice is not asserted primitive in the Neron-Severi group.
Singularity types and geometric automorphism orbits of the 64 cubic surfaces are not determined.
Potential unindexed equivalent cubic-subdivisor enumerations and the unread full text of arXiv:2607.10090 remain literature risks.
title: Sixty-four irreducible cubic sections of the Schur quartic twenty-four-line divisor
